purpose: Attribute automatic Trooper-orb net-worth increases to named players.
Test whether observed recipients match the documented 45 meter sharing range.
Compare player geometry at the originating Trooper death and at the later orb resolution.
Keep collision-affected events separate from clean recipient evidence.
Do not treat raw net-worth-window totals as exact orb souls until geometry and collision tests support them.

definitions.automaticTrooperAward: A Script 65 AUTO_AWARD_SECURE Trooper outcome with no player hit on the orb.
definitions.observedRecipient: A winner-team player with a positive m_iGoldNetWorth delta in the validated P0_P8 award window.
definitions.rangeSupportedRecipient: An observed recipient reconstructed within 45 meters of the source position at the preferred geometry moment.
definitions.exactRangeMatch: A collision-free event where the observed-recipient set exactly equals the in-range player set.
definitions.observedDeltaWarning: An observed net-worth delta can contain batched or unrelated economy. Treat the summed delta as telemetry evidence, not yet a canonical exact-souls total.

geometryComparison.interpretation: Observed collision-free recipient deltas partially match the documented 45m range at death. Best searched threshold: 54.86m (F1 87.9%).
